title: Quickly closing certains menu buttons makes mouse not function correctly
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.dev1 and above
- Not reproducible in 4.5.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7260) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 15.79 GiB memory

### Issue description

By opening and immediately closing menus like for example, the one that let´s you edit the editor docks position or the one that let´s you edit Sun and Environment Setting you will be unable to see tooltips, although it still highlights the button you hover and the first time you try to click on a button after you will be unable to, with some exceptions mentioned below.

Notes:
- Switching to single window mode seems to fix it
- This seems to be a specific type of menu causing as attempting to reproduce it with a button that opens a dropdown menu won´t work
- In the scene dock, only if you attempt this bug with the dock position button of that respective dock, you can successfully use the 2D Scene, 3D scene and User Interface button
- If you attempt this bug using the dock position button and attempt to interact with a button, inside the same dock, that opens a dropdown menu the menu will open and immediately close




### Steps to reproduce

- Open a new project
- Double click on the "Edit Sun and Environment Settings"
- Attempt to read a tooltip
- Attempt to press a button
